judgement.notes: Moduli 5 and 7 are coprime, so CRT gives a unique residue class mod 35. The smallest positive representative is 17: 17 mod 5 = 2 and 17 mod 7 = 3. The previous representative 17 - 35 = -18 is not positive, so 17 is uniquely the smallest positive integer solution. Answer is an exact integer, already in simplest form.
